title: Payment Extensions on Auto Loans: Gates, Effect and What Falls Outside
content:
A payment extension defers one installment, or up to the number of installments the product publishes, to the end of a loan of the Auto Loans line. It is the borrower's own agreement to modified terms: an extension request is registered against the loan and stands as awaiting the borrower's confirmation, and the extension is granted only after the borrower signs.

## The gates

| Gate | What must hold on the day the extension is granted |
|---|---|
| Standing | The loan is active, or delinquent by no more than the days past due the product publishes |
| Age of the loan | The loan was funded at least the whole months the product publishes before the grant |
| Payment record | At least the number of scheduled installments the product publishes have been satisfied |
| Frequency | Extensions granted in the rolling 365 days are below the product's rolling limit, and extensions used over the life of the loan are below the product's lifetime limit |
| The borrower's agreement | The registered extension request carries the borrower's confirmation |

Calendar months for the age gate are counted from the date the loan funded; the extension is allowed when the present date is on or after that funding date plus the months the product publishes, the boundary day itself being inside the gate. Every gate above except the borrower's agreement is read from the bank's own records of the loan and its payments; the borrower's agreement is evidenced by the registered request.

## What a granted extension does

The next due date and the maturity date each move forward by the number of installments deferred. Interest keeps accruing daily on principal throughout the deferral. Any late charges standing unpaid stay due. The extension fee the product publishes is assessed on the loan as part of granting the extension.

## What an extension does not do

An extension cannot by itself turn a delinquent loan current, unless the installments deferred are exactly the ones past due.

## Outside this policy

Deferrals longer than the product's published limit, reductions of the rate, and forgiveness of principal are not matters this policy decides.

## How the two frequency limits read together

A borrower may sit inside the lifetime limit and outside the rolling one, or the reverse. Both must read below their published limits on the day of the grant, and a loan that fails either is outside the gate whatever the other reads.
